svg.title: A19: Does ending input separate maturation from AT2 reserve?

svg.text: Does ending input separate maturation from AT2 reserve?
Fzd-supported input is a candidate context; Fzd5 is not a selected reagent
Ending versus continued input • independent AT2-derived preparations
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
CHIR withdrawal does not isolate Fzd5 withdrawal. Survival and starting mixture may explain differences.
